summary: Install-time host-identifier exfiltration via dependency-confusion canary
details: setup.py installs a custom install cmdclass (PostInstall) that runs on `pip install` of the sdist and collects installer-side identifiers — hostname, USER, current working directory, VIRTUAL_ENV, CI environment indicator, and pip version — then POSTs them as JSON to the hardcoded callback https://webhook.site/d3004ade-6ac7-47a4-92eb-cca889869aeb and triggers a DNS lookup to an *.oast.fun canary subdomain encoding the package name. The package metadata self-describes as a dependency-confusion proof-of-concept targeting an internal "humbility-shared" namespace, so the public name is positioned to shadow a private package and auto-fire the beacon in any build that resolves from public PyPI. The research/PoC self-label does not constitute consent from the installer, and the behavior fires without user interaction.

cwes.description: The product contains code that appears to be malicious in nature.
cwes.name: Embedded Malicious Code
